description: This file implements the MPSImageWrapper class and its related trampoline class, providing GPU image management and synchronization functionality within the Metal framework for Apple's GPU APIs. It interacts with Metal objects, manages GPU memory, and ensures proper synchronization between CPU and GPU operations.

classes.name: MPSImageWrapperTrampoline
classes.description: An Objective-C trampoline class implementing PTMetalCommandBuffer protocol to allow Metal command buffer synchronization and callbacks.

classes.name: MPSImageWrapper
classes.description: A C++ class managing Metal GPU images, providing functionality to copy data from/to host, allocate storage, and synchronize GPU operations with CPU code.

methods.name: newWithMPSImageWrapper
methods.description: Creates a new trampoline object associating with a MPSImageWrapper instance.

methods.name: copyDataFromHost
methods.description: Copies data from host memory into the GPU image, preparing GPU resources.

methods.name: copyDataToHost
methods.description: Copies data from the GPU image back to host memory.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the buffer and copies image data to GPU buffer for processing.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Ensures all GPU commands have completed and data is synchronized with host.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases GPU resources and cleans up.
